title: Project Portfolio
rankingNote: Ranks are editorial comparisons based on inspected repository implementation and broad internship relevance; they are not measured scores.

projects.name: Multimodal Reasoning Assistant
projects.description: A Streamlit assistant that analyzes uploaded images into structured evidence, detects ambiguous questions, generates evidence-grounded responses, and validates both claims and response language.
features: Image-to-structured-evidence analysis
Conversation context with reusable recent image evidence
Language and mixed-language detection
Ambiguity check with clarification branch
Separate evidence and language validation stages
Visible reasoning-stage trace in the UI
limitations: LLM-based image interpretation, ambiguity decisions, and validation are fallible.
Conversation state is held in Streamlit session state rather than durable storage.

projects.name: arXiv CS Research Assistant
projects.description: A research assistant that prepares a filtered arXiv subset and provides semantic paper search, local-LLM explanations, keyword extraction, conversation-aware Q&A, and embedding visualization.
features: Streaming JSONL filter and seeded sampling by arXiv category prefix
FAISS semantic retrieval over paper titles and abstracts
LLM summaries and conversational Q&A with recent-turn context
Unsupervised YAKE keyword extraction
PCA projection of sampled paper embeddings
limitations: The generated FAISS index and full raw arXiv metadata file are not included.
The answer prompt permits general model knowledge when retrieved context is incomplete.
Documented performance claims have not been independently reproduced.

projects.name: MedQuAD Medical QA Chatbot
projects.description: A Streamlit medical question-answering application using local semantic retrieval and Ollama, with utilities for incrementally adding new CSV or text knowledge sources.
features: FAISS retrieval over the included MedQuAD CSV
Prompt-structured answer and medical-entity response
Incoming CSV/TXT discovery and content-hash deduplication
Incremental vector-index updates
Optional scheduled update process
limitations: Generated FAISS index and ingestion manifest are not included.
The updater does not implement a text-splitting stage despite the README describing chunking.
The UI does not retain multi-turn conversation or display retrieved source documents.
The README's dataset pair count differs from the included CSV's physical line count; the count was not treated as a verified record total.
The project documentation states it is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

projects.name: Real-Time Fraud Detector
projects.description: A fraud-classification demo combining a class-weighted Random Forest training pipeline, local TCP transaction replay, and a Streamlit inference dashboard.
features: Stratified train/test split and amount scaling
Class-weighted Random Forest training
Classification report, PR-AUC, and ROC-AUC calculation
Newline-delimited JSON transaction replay over local TCP
Live dashboard metrics, rolling trend, alerts, and local event logging
limitations: The stream is a local dataset replay with intentionally injected fraud examples, not a live financial feed.
The documented training dataset is absent; serialized model assets are present.
README performance metrics have not been independently reproduced.
No dependency manifest is present.

projects.name: Bank Customer Churn Predictor
projects.description: A Streamlit churn-prediction demo backed by a scikit-learn logistic-regression pipeline with explicit demographic encoding, numeric scaling, and feature ordering.
features: Identifier-column removal and median imputation for numeric columns
Geography and gender one-hot encoding
Scaling of four continuous features
Fixed 11-feature model input order
Interactive churn prediction UI
limitations: Training data file churn_data.csv is not included.
The UI supplies fixed baseline values for several model features.
feature_blueprint.pkl is present but not used by the inspected UI.
README performance metrics have not been independently reproduced.
No dependency manifest is present.

projects.name: Destiny AI Voice Assistant
projects.description: A Python desktop voice-assistant demo that combines custom wake-word detection, speech input, local LLM responses, speech synthesis, and a system-telemetry HUD.
features: Custom ONNX wake-word model loading and threshold detection
Microphone command capture and transcription
Ollama chat response and pyttsx3 speech output
Background threads and GUI event scheduling
CPU/RAM telemetry and status/log HUD
limitations: Command transcription uses SpeechRecognition's Google recognition service, so this part is not fully local as the README claims.
No dependency manifest is present.
README setup directory name and wake-word wording do not fully align with the inspected project code.

projects.name: Customer Service Chatbot & Sentiment Tracker
projects.description: A Streamlit customer-support Q&A demo that retrieves answers from a CSV-backed FAISS index and prompts a local LLM for a sentiment-aware response.
features: CSV knowledge-base indexing and vector retrieval
Prompt-formatted sentiment, emotion, and answer output
Session-based positive, negative, and neutral counters
limitations: Sentiment is prompt-based and inferred by parsing generated text, not produced by a separate trained classifier.
requirements.txt lists google-generativeai while the inspected implementation uses Ollama.
The source imports langchain_classic, which is not declared in requirements.txt.
A generated FAISS index is not present.

projects.name: Binance Futures Testnet Trading CLI
projects.description: A Python command-line tool that validates basic order inputs and submits signed market or limit orders to the Binance Futures testnet.
features: CLI parsing for symbol, side, order type, quantity, and price
Basic input validation
HMAC-SHA256 signed HTTP requests
Market and GTC limit order payloads
Console and file logging
limitations: Implements testnet order submission, not a signal-generation strategy or live trading.
Does not implement portfolio/risk management or exchange-specific precision/filter validation.
Credential configuration has fallback handling; use reviewed testnet credentials via the intended environment configuration.

projects.name: AI Core Foundation Pipeline
projects.description: A dependency-free Python learning project demonstrating basic feature-matrix profiling and summaries of a mock accuracy history.
features: Manual row/column count and matrix flattening
Global minimum and maximum calculation
Average and peak accuracy-history summary
Hard-coded demonstration inputs
limitations: Uses mock data and does not train or evaluate a model.
Matrix profiling assumes rectangular, non-empty data for min/max calculation.

projects.name: NumPy Array Exercises
projects.description: A Python 3 Jupyter notebook containing introductory NumPy array-operation exercises.
features: Array creation and standard deviation
Reshape, flatten, and transpose operations
Zeros, ones, identity, and range arrays
Random arrays, sorting, uniqueness, concatenation, and splitting
limitations: Notebook exercises only; no README, dependency manifest, package structure, or application entry point.
